### What's Changed

<!-- flagship -->
**Your agent can now ask cwcli for a bench's live URL.**
`cwcli axi url` reports the host address a bench actually answers on and checks it with a real request, naming the site it asked. Nothing else on the agent surface states that address today; the existing health check only measures the internal container port.

**Transfers and restores stop running out of disk.**
A sendme transfer or a restore used to lean on your system's temp partition, which is often small, and could exhaust it mid-run. Both now stream through cwcli's own home and copy each file once instead of twice. Receive mode also checks free space before the download starts. When disk space really is the problem, cwcli says so plainly instead of failing with a cryptic I/O error.

**Restores check the site and ticket before the download, not after.**
A restore now validates what it needs up front, so a mistake surfaces before a multi-gigabyte transfer runs rather than after.

**A bare `cwcli` prints help again.**
On some installs it crashed with a raw traceback instead of showing the usage text every other zero-argument CLI shows.

**Long `init` phases stay visibly alive.**
A bench build can run for minutes with nothing on screen, which looked identical to a hang. Long phases now announce themselves and keep their progress visible for as long as they take.
